name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
description: Used by the Claude Code CLI (`claude-agent.ts`) for headless auth when a workflow run's agentConfig.cli is "claude-agent". Read directly by the `claude` subprocess from its inherited environment — this package never reads the value itself.

name: CURSOR_API_KEY
description: Used by the Cursor CLI (`cursor-agent.ts`) for headless auth when a workflow run's agentConfig.cli is "cursor-agent". Read directly by the `cursor-agent` subprocess from its inherited environment — this package never reads the value itself.
